name: Gyroscope GYD L1 CCIP escrow arbitrary call on message receipt
summary: GydL1CCIPEscrow._ccipReceive sends the bridged GYD to the message's recipient and then runs recipient.functionCall(data) as the escrow. The attacker bridged 1 wei GYD from Arbitrum naming the GYD token as recipient and approve(attacker, max) as data, then pulled the escrow's whole GYD balance and sold part of it on several chains.
notes: The last UUPS upgrade before the exploit selected GydL1CCIPEscrow 0x79ec4a44, whose _ccipReceive makes the message-supplied call; Arbitrum was registered as a source at the proxy's creation. The Arbitrum send transaction in refs only queued the message and runs no defective code.

The campaign's transferFrom drained the escrow under the approval the anchor granted. GYD is valued at the attacker's realised proceeds on six chains (rule 12): its sales drained GYD liquidity and about 5.27M GYD stayed unsold, so this is a lower bound. GYD re-bridged to L2s is routing, not a recovery.
